reader_summary.headline: Today we're breaking down Arthur J.
reader_summary.overview: Today we're breaking down Arthur J. Gallagher, a global insurance brokerage. AJG was established in 1927 by Arthur James Gallagher and is now one of the largest insurance brokerages by revenue, exceeding $10 billion. AJG competes with the likes of Marsh McLennan, Aon, and Willis Towers Watson.

key_points.text: To break down Gallagher, I am joined by Mike Hayward, a portfolio manager at WCM Asset Management.
During this conversation, we discussed the company's successful acquisition strategy, the strength of the insurance brokerage industry.
10 East is a platform where qualified investors can co-invest on a deal-by-deal basis across private equity, private credit, real estate ventures.
